pages.title: About Us
pages.contentHtml:
Welcome to the world of 2202 Love Colombo, a unique streetwear brand that’s proudly crafted in the heart of Sri Lanka. Founded in 2020, our brand embodies the essence of affordable luxury with a twist.

Affordable Luxury, Locally Crafted

We take pride in offering an affordable luxury concept without compromising on quality. All our products are crafted in our very own state-of-the-art garment factory, ensuring the highest standards of production. We believe that luxury should be accessible to all.

Uniquely Limited Pieces

At 2202 Love Colombo, we celebrate individuality. Our pieces are unique and produced in limited quantities, so you can be sure that you’re wearing something truly special.

Ageless, Timeless, and Beyond Trends

We don’t follow the conventional fashion calendar. Our collections are ageless, timeless, and not bound by seasonal trends. We design clothing that stands the test of time and transcends fleeting fashion fads.

Eco-Friendly Initiatives

We care about our planet, and that’s why we use recycled fabrics in the majority of our creations. Sustainability is at the core of our brand, and we’re committed to making a positive impact.

The Creative Force Behind 2202 Love Colombo

Our brand’s concept and vision are brought to life by Heshan de Silva, who serves as the creative director and head designer of Nihal Apparel Pvt Ltd. Heshan’s expertise and experience, having studied fashion design at RMIT University in Australia and fashion retail management at the Art Institute in Washington, D.C., are the driving forces behind our unique and innovative designs.

Join us on this fashion journey where artistry meets eco-consciousness, and luxury meets affordability. Explore the world of 2202 Love Colombo, where style knows no limits.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.contentHtml:
At 2202 Love Colombo, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring that your personal information is handled securely and responsibly.

Information We Collect

When you place an order or interact with our website, we may collect the following information:

  • Name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Delivery address
  • Payment information (processed securely through our payment gateway)

How We Use Your Information

Your information is used to:

  • Process and deliver your orders
  • Provide customer support
  • Communicate with you regarding your order
  • Improve our website and customer experience

Payment Security

All online payments are processed through secure payment gateways. We do not store your credit or debit card details on our website.

Data Protection

Your personal information is kept confidential and will not be sold, traded, or shared with third parties except where necessary to process your order, deliver products, or comply with legal obligations.

Cookies

Our website may use cookies to enhance your browsing experience and improve website functionality.

Your Consent

By using our website, you consent to the collection and use of your information as outlined in this privacy policy.

Image Rights

All images, designs, graphics, and visual content displayed on this website are the property of 2202 Love Colombo.

The use, reproduction, distribution, or modification of any images or content from this website is strictly prohibited without prior written permission from 2202 Love Colombo.

All intellectual property rights related to the content on this website are protected under applicable copyright and intellectual property laws.

pages.title: Delivery Policy
pages.contentHtml:
Thank you for shopping with 2202 Love Colombo. Please review our delivery policy below for details regarding order processing and shipping.

Delivery Locations

We currently deliver within Sri Lanka only. At this time, we do not offer international shipping.

Delivery Charges

  • Standard delivery charges range between LKR 300 – LKR 350, depending on your location.
  • Free delivery is available for orders above LKR 5,000.

Order Processing

Orders are usually processed within 1–2 working days after order confirmation.

Estimated Delivery Time

  • Colombo & suburbs: 1–3 working days
  • Other areas in Sri Lanka: 2–5 working days

Please note that delivery times may vary depending on courier schedules, public holidays, or unforeseen circumstances.

Delivery Information

Please ensure that the delivery address and contact number provided during checkout are correct. Our courier partner may contact you prior to delivery.

Order Issues

If you experience any issues with your delivery or have not received your order within the estimated timeframe, please contact us.

Contact Us

Email: info@2202lovecolombo.com
Phone: 077 367 2202

pages.title: Return & Refund Policy
pages.contentHtml:
At 2202 Love Colombo, we want you to love your purchase. If you are not completely satisfied with your order, we are happy to offer exchanges under the following conditions.

Exchanges

Items can be exchanged within 7 days of receiving the order.

To qualify for an exchange, items must be:

  • Unused
  • Unworn
  • Unwashed
  • In original condition with tags attached

All exchanges are subject to stock availability.

Non-Returnable Items

The following items cannot be returned or exchanged:

  • Sale or discounted items
  • Items damaged due to misuse
  • Items returned without original tags or packaging

Exchange Process

To request an exchange, please contact us with:

  • Your order number
  • The item you wish to exchange

You may contact us via:

  • Email
  • WhatsApp
  • Instagram DM

Our team will guide you through the exchange process.

Shipping Costs

Customers are responsible for return shipping costs unless the item received was defective or incorrect.

Damaged or Incorrect Items

If you receive a damaged or incorrect item, please contact us within 48 hours of receiving your order and we will arrange a replacement.

Contact Us

Email: info@2202lovecolombo.com
Phone: 077 367 2202
